acceptanceCriteria: For each family, a decision records merge or keep with the evidence (shipping, profiles, scripts, CI workflows, docs that name the binary); merged families keep their wire/profile IDs and update every script, workflow and doc reference in the same change.
The ACP per-binary isolation question is answered from the ACP spec before any analyzer merge.
No shipped binary name changes under this ticket.
body: Owner 2026-10-17 asked to make sure the tooling is split into appropriate binaries. Read-only audit (docs/build-log/2026-10-17-binary-boundary-audit.md) of the 52 cmd/ companions: all are thin wrappers over internal packages and only nine ship in the companion bundle (internal/companionrelease/companionrelease.go:121-129). Candidate merges of unshipped families, each with its own subcommands: (1) dev-only corvint-release from release-candidate, release-gate, release-install, companion-release, public-release-check, readiness-record and go-toolchain-receipt; (2) corvint-postmerge from postmerge-connect, -host-launcher, -metrics, -workflow (intake has its own CI containment workflow, .github/workflows/intake-containment.yml, and needs care); (3) corvint-corpus from corpus-http, -parity, -republish (corpus-mcp may stay an MCP server); (4) corvint-analyzer <lang> from the 17 analyzer binaries, keeping envelope IDs such as corvint-analyzer-java/v0; unverified whether ACP requires per-binary isolation, and script/check-analyzer-python-* and check-sql-native-ratchets.sh name cmd paths. cem-candidate + cem-experiments was judged low value. Keep shipped or server binaries as they are (tasks, update, mcp, docs-mcp, test-validity-mcp, console, dashboard-snapshot, lsp, pulse, remote-provider, work-queue).
title: Consolidate unshipped companion families: corvint-release, corvint-postmerge, corvint-corpus, corvint-analyzer <lang>
